propositions: Verifier step budget exhausts on legitimate multi-criteria validation (6-14 AC epics), marking provable criteria as false unmet despite safe tool-use limits; raising defaults and adding evidence-surface scaling terms (24 steps/criterion, 160 min floor, 960 clamp; +16 per direct child +16 overhead) allows 20+ ACs within budget

Cross-run re-verification re-proves all criteria from scratch (~10 min/cycle) despite unchanged content; caching validated PASS verdicts keyed by criterion-text hash + scoped git blob fingerprint (file_impact paths + direct-child blobs) and seeding them into run banks avoids re-work while invalidating on content changes
Seeded PASS verdicts bypass finalizer judgment and cannot be downgraded by echo mismatches, isolating cross-run credit from same-run corrections and preventing attestation laundering

Childful budget sizing (epics with direct-child traversal costs) and childless fallback both use the single shared formula in both primary sizing and recovery pool consumers; enumeration failures fail-open to childless floor without raising

Ref-targeted verification (--ref <sha> close flows, stacked stories) binds cached verdicts to the commit tree they were proven against via verified_ref_sha and ref-scoped blob fingerprints, preventing illegitimate cache reuse across mismatched refs
